text: The United States Virgin Islands are a group of islands that are US overseas territories. As such, it is counted as **the US** for country streaks purposes.
text_zh: 美屬維京群島是一群屬於美國海外領土的島嶼。因此，就連勝紀錄而言，它被算作**美國**。

text: Car coverage on the islands will have a large, visible street view car, which will either be **red** or **white**. Details about where to find each car can be found in the region guessing section.
text_zh: 島上的車輛街景會有一個大型、清晰可見的街景車，顏色不是**紅色**就是**白色**。關於在哪裡可以找到每輛車的詳細資訊，可以在區域猜測章節中找到。

text: A **unique blend of architecture** is found on the United States Virgin Islands. The primary influences are European Renaissance, Spanish Baroque, Rococo and Victorian styles. Facades with large arches are common; as well as central plazas and courtyards.
text_zh: 在美屬維京群島上可以發現**獨特的建築融合風格**。主要的影響包括文藝復興、西班牙巴洛克、洛可可和維多利亞風格。帶有大拱門的立面很常見，中央廣場和庭院也是如此。

text: Owing to its former status as a Danish colony, some streets and localities still have **Danish names** (e.g. _gade_) or display bilingual signs. This is most common in the historical downtown areas.
text_zh: 由於其曾為丹麥殖民地的歷史地位，某些街道和地名仍然保有**丹麥名稱**（例如 _gade_）或顯示雙語標示。這在歷史市中心區域最為常見。

text: Licence plates are short, typically either having a **bright blue** or a **dark blue** design.
text_zh: 車牌很短，通常採用**亮藍色**或**深藍色**設計。

text: Primary roads on the Southern US Virgin Island of St. Croix follow a loose **grid pattern**. Main roads are angled from WSW to ENE, with intersecting roads angled from NNW to SSE. In contrast, the Northern Islands of St. John and St. Thomas have much curvier roads.
text_zh: 美屬維京群島南部聖克魯斯島（St. Croix）的主幹道遵循寬鬆的**棋盤狀網格**。主幹道從西南西（WSW）向東北東（ENE）延伸，交叉道路則從西北北（NNW）向東南南（SSE）延伸。相比之下，北部的聖約翰島（St. John）和聖托馬斯島（St. Thomas）道路彎曲得多。

text: The United States Virgin Islands features 3 unique Google cars. The first of which is shown here. This red truck with a **red cab** can only be seen in the southern island of St Croix. This is the **most common** car that will be seen as St Croix has the most coverage.
text_zh: 美屬維京群島有 3 種獨特的 Google 車。其中第一種如這裡所示。這輛帶有**紅色車頭**的紅色卡車只能在南部的聖克魯斯島看到。這是**最常見**會看到的車輛，因為聖克魯斯島的街景最多。

text: A white car **without** an antenna can also be seen on St Croix, however it will be less common than the red car.
text_zh: 在聖克魯斯島上也可以看到一輛**沒有**天線的白色車，不過它會比紅色車少見。

text: A white car **with an antenna** can only be seen in the northern islands of St Thomas and St John. The cab is also noticeably shorter than the other two cars.
text_zh: 一輛**帶有天線**的白色車只能在北部的聖托馬斯島和聖約翰島看到。其車頭也明顯比其他兩輛車短。

text: Two **boat trekkers** are found on the north coast of St Croix. The boat cannot be seen, however the trekker can be identified by the blue waters and hilly islands. The area near Buck Island National Park also has a distinct [pink tint](https://goo.gl/maps/kiRppxZK9vQVe3FA7) to the camera.
text_zh: 在聖克魯斯島的北海岸可以找到兩艘**船隻徒步拍攝**。看不見船本身，但可以透過湛藍的海水和多山的小島來辨識徒步拍攝街景。巴克島國家紀念公園（Buck Island National Park）附近的相機也帶有明顯的[粉紅色調](https://goo.gl/maps/kiRppxZK9vQVe3FA7)。
